plainTranslation: Raw power and drive, fused. Intense passion, intense conflict. Exciting and combustible. Watch coercion and the fight-to-make-up loop. Aim the force at something shared. If it runs on domination, step back and prioritize safety.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
